737:t_109:5.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「So this is the power of $$真化融合$$...!」

737:t_109:6.en:
$$竜馬$$
「It isn't just that! We've defeated plenty of enemies on our way here!」

737:t_109:7.en:
$$隼人$$
「The $$インベーダー#robot$$s, the $$宇宙怪獣$$, $$ヴィルダーク$$, the army of evil gods, $$アサキム$$, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$...」

737:t_109:9.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Brace yourselves, $$御使い$$s! We'll surpass you!」

737:t_109:10.en:
$$竜馬$$
「And we'll keep getting stronger without limit! That's our evolution!!」

737:t_110:0.en:
$$タケル$$
「You are the cause of every war in the universe...! I'll cut it off at the root right here!!」

737:t_110:1.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「That power of love you're so good at? If so, it's useless!」

737:t_110:2.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「We discarded such primitive emotional patterns 120 million years ago!」

737:t_110:5.en:
$$タケル$$
「By abandoning love, you lost the truth of the universe! As a result, you fell into beings who can casually take others' lives!」

737:t_110:6.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「$$テンプティ$$ and the others fell!?」

737:t_110:7.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「I will not tolerate humans barely at the threshold of evolution denying our existence!」

737:t_110:8.en:
$$タケル$$
「I'll say it as many times as it takes! You forgot love, and you must not be allowed to exist in this universe!」

737:t_110:9.en:
$$タケル$$
「That's why I'll fight with this $$ゴッドマーズ$$, keeping my oath to my brother in my heart!!」

737:t_111:0.en:
$$シモン$$
「There you are, ringleaders! I'll settle this with you!」

737:t_111:1.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「You're so funny! It's like you actually think you can beat the $$御使い$$s!」

737:t_111:2.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「Do not underestimate them, $$テンプティ$$. That very recklessness has at times given the Earth species power.」

737:t_111:4.en:
$$シモン$$
「Your god act ends here! If you can take my drill and still stay that smug, I'll give you some credit!」

737:t_112:0.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「If we defeat that thing, everything will end!」

737:t_112:1.en:
$$カズミ$$
「Let's go, $$ノリコ$$! We'll put everything we have into this!」

737:t_112:2.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「How foolish... Even if you were to defeat us, the force of annihilation would engulf you, and you would vanish with the universe.」

737:t_112:3.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「In other words, you'll destroy your loved ones and the universe all together with your own hands!」

737:t_112:4.en:
$$カズミ$$
「Is that all you have to say?」

737:t_112:6.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「I'm not listening to stories that only suit you! We'll follow the path we believe in!」

737:t_112:7.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「By defeating you as you stand in our way!!」

737:t_113:0.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「How pitiful. You fight desperately even after losing your power?」

737:t_113:2.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「What a shame. If you'd obtained eternity too, you could have remained a $$トップレス$$ forever.」

737:t_113:3.en:
$$ラルク$$
「I'm still myself even without my $$トップレス$$ abilities! I haven't lost my will to fight!」

737:t_113:4.en:
$$ラルク$$
「Eternity, my ass! I'll never lose to you, who lost what matters by obtaining it!!」

737:t_114:0.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「So you are one crystallization of Earth humanity's wisdom?」

737:t_114:1.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「If so, that's hilarious! You come at us when you can't beat the $$御使い$$s no matter how hard you struggle!」

737:t_114:2.en:
$$ノノ$$
「It's true that $$ノノ$$ is clumsy and silly, and Big Sis sometimes says $$ノノ$$ can't read the room.」

737:t_114:3.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
「It's true that $$ノノ$$ is clumsy and silly, and Big Sis sometimes says $$ノノ$$ can't read the room.」

737:t_114:4.en:
$$ダイバスター$$
「It's true that $$ノノ$$ is clumsy and silly, and Big Sis sometimes says $$ノノ$$ can't read the room.」

737:t_114:5.en:
$$ノノ$$
「But! I believe I'm far better than humans corrupted by evil like you!」

737:t_114:6.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
「But! I believe I'm far better than humans corrupted by evil like you!」

737:t_114:7.en:
$$ダイバスター$$
「But! I believe I'm far better than humans corrupted by evil like you!」

737:t_114:9.en:
$$ノノ$$
「The worse the villain, the more they justify themselves like that!」

737:t_114:10.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
「The worse the villain, the more they justify themselves like that!」

737:t_114:11.en:
$$ダイバスター$$
「The worse the villain, the more they justify themselves like that!」

737:t_114:12.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Brace yourselves, $$御使い$$s! $$ノノ$$ will fight for all the lives in this universe!!」

737:t_114:13.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
「Brace yourselves, $$御使い$$s! $$ノノ$$ will fight for all the lives in this universe!!」

737:t_114:14.en:
$$ダイバスター$$
「Brace yourselves, $$御使い$$s! $$ノノ$$ will fight for all the lives in this universe!!」

737:t_115:1.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「So you carry on the blood of the beast.」

737:t_115:2.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「You're only at the first stage of evolution! You're sorely mistaken if you think you can beat higher-dimensional beings like us!」

737:t_115:3.en:
$$くらら$$
「You don't seem to know what happened to the ones who made those arrogant assumptions.」

737:t_115:4.en:
$$朔哉$$
「We defeated all those villains to get here!」

737:t_115:5.en:
$$ジョニー$$
「No one can stop our blood... no, humanity's blood from boiling!」

737:t_115:6.en:
$$エイーダ$$
「That's right! Neither fate nor the emissaries of God can stop it!」

737:t_115:8.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「This is the blood of the beast...! What we forgot long ago!」

737:t_115:9.en:
$$葵$$
「This heat will burn you to ashes!」

737:t_115:10.en:
$$葵$$
「Let's fight, $$御使い$$s! Let's do iiiit!!」

737:t_116:0.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「Look, look, $$ドクトリン$$! There are office workers here!」

737:t_116:1.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「No others could be more suited to the words 'not knowing their place.'」

737:t_116:2.en:
$$赤木$$
「What's so strange about office workers fighting!?」

737:t_116:3.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「It's so stupid! There are easier jobs if you just want to earn money!」

737:t_116:4.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「You are fools who let circumstances sweep you along and wandered all the way here.」

737:t_116:5.en:
$$青山$$
「I can't deny that circumstances swept us along, but I don't want you thinking that's all there is to us.」

737:t_116:6.en:
$$いぶき$$
「At the very least, we're choosing to fight you now of our own free will!」

737:t_116:8.en:
$$青山$$
「$$赤木$$! Say it to those guys who keep acting like they're our rulers!」

737:t_116:9.en:
$$いぶき$$
「I'm counting on you to give them your best line!」

737:t_116:10.en:
$$赤木$$
「Right! Clean out your ears and listen up, $$御使い$$s!」

737:t_116:11.en:
$$赤木$$
「We will never lose! Even office workers can protect the peace!!」

737:t_117:0.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「The $$メガデウス$$, $$ザ・ビッグ$$... They are the power those who escaped us prepared to protect their paradise...」

737:t_117:2.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「And that city abandoned its past and future after its battle with us.」

737:t_117:3.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「I see... So the memories of fire were the battle between $$ザ・ビッグ$$ and you.」

737:t_117:4.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「I never imagined I could recover lost Memories in a place like this.」

737:t_117:6.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「How insolent of him, in our very presence!」

737:t_117:7.en:
$$ドロシー#bigo$$
「Expecting common sense from $$ロジャー$$ is pointless. He's free.」
